entities.name: ESM information request procedure
entities.description: A procedure used by the UE and PDN GW to exchange protocol configuration options.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: An information element used for exchanging protocol configuration options when supported end-to-end by network and UE.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options IE
entities.description: An information element used for exchanging protocol configuration options when extended PCO is not supported.

entities.name: Extended PCO supported conditions for UE
entities.description: Conditions under which extended PCO is considered supported end-to-end from UE perspective: UE in NB-S1 mode, APN for UAS services, non-IP/Ethernet PDN type, or network indicated support and included extended PCO IE.

entities.name: Extended PCO supported conditions for MME
entities.description: Conditions under which extended PCO is considered supported end-to-end from MME perspective: UE in NB-S1 mode, APN for UAS services, non-IP/Ethernet PDN type, or UE indicated support and MME received extended PCO IE from PDN GW.

entities.name: NB-S1 mode
entities.description: UE operating mode for narrowband S1 interface.

entities.name: APN for UAS services
entities.description: Access Point Name configured for Unmanned Aircraft System services.

entities.name: Non-IP or Ethernet PDN type
entities.description: Packet Data Network type set to non-IP or Ethernet.

relations.description: ESM information request procedure can contain extended protocol configuration options IE when supported.
ESM information request procedure can contain protocol configuration options IE when extended PCO is not supported.
Extended PCO support condition for UE requires UE to be in NB-S1 mode.
Extended PCO support condition for UE is guarded by APN being for UAS services.
Extended PCO support condition for UE is guarded by PDN type being non-IP or Ethernet.
Extended PCO support condition for MME requires UE to be in NB-S1 mode.
Extended PCO support condition for MME is guarded by APN being for UAS services.
Extended PCO support condition for MME is guarded by PDN type being non-IP or Ethernet.
